To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FASTER achieves up-to-orders-of-magnitude better performance for concurrent key-value store workloads than systems that are deployed widely today.

(1) FASTER, an embedded high-level-language component that combines a latchfree concurrent hash index and a hybrid log-structured recordstore, achieves up to ordersof- magnitude better throughput than existing systems; (2) FASTER can work with any back-end storage such as SSDs or cloud storage; (3) FASTER can be easily integrated with cloud applications and statestores to enable fast, scalable, and durable state management.

FASTER achieves orders-of-magnitude higher throughput than systems deployed in production today, is built as an easily embedded high-level language system using dynamic code generation and is adaptable to a wide range of storage back-ends such as local SSDs or cloud storage.

the following question: How can we design a high-level language component for state management that is easy to embed in applications and services and yet is highly scalable and adaptable to varying memory capacities?

building a high-performance and scalable key-value store that is easy to integrate into applications, and is suitable for a variety of storage back-ends.

FASTER is an easy-to-use, efficient, and highly scalable embedded key-value store, and it can be easily integrated into any cloud service or application.

we demonstrate FASTER as an embedded concurrent key-value store that is orders-of-magnitude faster than existing state-of-the-art key-value stores and that can be used to build a wide variety of data-intensive applications and state management systems.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FASTER is an embedded concurrent key-value store that can work with any high-level language, and can be deployed in the cloud, on the edge, or on mobile devices.
FASTER is a new key-value storage system that combines a latchfree hash index with a hybrid log, and can work seamlessly with any storage backend such as local SSDs or cloud storage.

FASTER enables developers to easily integrate a highly concurrent, high-throughput, and low-latency key-value store into any application, while providing the performance and durability guarantees of a distributed storage system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
state management is not just a performance issue but also an important design consideration for cloud services and applications.
state management can be integrated deeply into the application code and can be implemented in a high-level language with low overhead.
